image_prompt.text: Angular metallic cubes and rectangular pillars scattered across the main arena floor, letting a retreating player break combat lock and disengage
Spawn pads set back against the perimeter wall and screened by cover blocks, so a fighter is never in an enemy's firing line the frame they appear
A low metallic perimeter wall with glowing neon accent strips, enclosing the whole arena
Ramps connecting the flat main floor up to the elevated edge platforms

layout_placement.text: Spawns for an 8-16 player match distributed around the raised edge platforms and behind cover, out of each other's sightlines
